errorSignature: Deleted main-tip secrets reappear as live files on stale public bot branches (bolt/*, vercel/*, jules/*)
rootCause: Key scrubbing was applied to main tip only; 12 orphaned agent-generated remote branches still carried complete 208-219 char Supabase anon+service_role JWTs bound to real project ref mrwhtxbhrzyttlsyuofc.
resolution: Snapshot branch tips to session files for recovery, issued a single atomic git push origin --delete of 12 stale refs (11 bot + 1 jules), pruned local tracking refs, and verified remaining heads contain no live-branch JWTs.
preventionRule: After leaking or scrubbing any secret, enumerate git ls-remote --heads and grep EVERY published branch for the secret fingerprint, not just main; delete stale bot branches immediately after their work lands.
